def_en: 1a) implying that the latter choice is preferred
1b) or if, introducing an example to be seen under a particular principle
2) whether, not the least, if, otherwise, also, and, then
kjv: also, and, either, if, at the least, [idiom] nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.
expl: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
etim: presumed to be the 'constructive' or genitival form of ; short for ;
